video.title: Searchable, Refreshable & Search Suggestions | Day 162
video.description:
Learn to explain how to search and update a list in SwiftUI: Searchable, Refreshable & Search Suggestions, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Searchable - A modifier that adds a search field to a screen and gives you the text the user types.
Refreshable - A modifier that lets the user pull a list down to run async code that loads new data.
Search Suggestions - A list of ideas that appears under the search field while the user types.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Searchable, Refreshable and Search Suggestions in English?

dialogue.title: Find a name fast

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my names list has 2000 rows, and users cannot find anything.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add Searchable. It puts a search field on the screen and gives you the typed text.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I added `.searchable(text:)`, and the field appears at the top.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice. Remember, Searchable only gives you the text. You must filter the list yourself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I show ideas while the user types?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, with Search Suggestions. It shows a list of ideas under the search field.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does `searchCompletion` fill the field when the user taps an idea?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. That is the best part of Search Suggestions.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One more thing. The data is old, and the user wants to update it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add Refreshable. The user pulls the list down, and your async code runs.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The spinner stays until the Refreshable closure finishes.
Add Searchable to find a name.
